propositions: The shared webhook/rerun secret is logged in plaintext in the uvicorn access log because the token is passed as a query parameter (?token=...) and uvicorn records the full request line including query strings to stderr/journald.

The webhook token equals GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN (the review bot's Gerrit credential) because config.py sets no separate WEBHOOK_TOKEN env var, making the exposed secret usable for both webhook authentication and Gerrit operations.

The exposure is fail-open with no alarm or error signal; the endpoints continue working normally while the secret silently leaks into journald and any logs derived from it (transcripts, tickets, future log-shipping).

The fix moves the secret from the query string to the X-Rebar-Token HTTP header (which uvicorn access logs do not record), with a TokenRedactingFilter as a backstop to scrub token= values from any logged request line.
The token logged before the fix must be rotated independently, since the code fix alone does not retroactively un-leak what is already in journald and shared log excerpts.
